# ELEVATOR 100: Descent into Fear > **Emergency Override Protocol Active.** The lower shaft has collapsed. The entity ascends at 3 meters per second. Ascend 100 floors before hydraulic seal failure. [![Play on itch.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/Play_on-itch.io-ff2449?style=for-the-badge&logo=itch.io&logoColor=white)](https://vimal9ram-nap.itch.io/elevator-100) [![GitHub Pages](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live_Demo-GitHub_Pages-2ea44f?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://vimal9ram-nap.github.io/elevator-100/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE) --- ### Play Directly in Browser [![Play Elevator 100 on itch.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/▶_CLICK_TO_PLAY_IN_BROWSER-ff2449?style=for-the-badge&logo=itch.io&logoColor=white)](https://vimal9ram-nap.itch.io/elevator-100)
--- ## Overview **Elevator 100** is a lightweight, atmospheric HTML5 horror survival game built entirely with native web technologies. Designed for zero-dependency execution, minimal memory overhead, and immersive retro CRT tension. --- ## Screenshots & Showcase | Start Interface & High Score | Terminal Passenger Logs | | :--------------------------------------: | :------------------------------------------: | | | | | System Error Override Hazard | Entity Visual Jumpscare | | :---------------------------------------: | :------------------------------------------: | | | | --- ## Key Features - **Procedural Sub-System Hazards:** Dynamic text-based code overrides on stalled hazard floors under a strict countdown timer. - **Pure Web Audio Synthesizer:** Real-time procedural audio synthesis generated on-the-fly with native Web Audio API oscillators — zero external sound files downloaded. - **Passenger Lore Terminal:** Uncover terminal notes and eerie logs left behind by previous elevator victims as you ascend. - **Distress Signal Link Sharing:** Built-in dynamic URL parameters allow players to share custom progress and distress links with friends. - **Local Ascent Tracking:** High scores and deepest floor records are tracked automatically using browser `localStorage`. --- ## Tech Stack - **HTML5 & CSS3:** Custom CRT scanline effects, glowing ambient drop-shadows, and responsive layout. - **JavaScript (ES6+):** Async game logic state management and mathematical puzzle generators. - **Web Audio API:** Custom oscillator graphs generating real-time low-frequency ambient hums, alarms, and jumpscare soundscapes. --- ## How to Run Locally Because the game uses native web technology, no build steps, node modules, or external servers are required. 1. **Clone the repository:** ```bash git clone [https://github.com/Vimal9RAM-NAP/elevator-100.git](https://github.com/Vimal9RAM-NAP/elevator-100.git) ``` 2. Navigate into the directory: ```bash cd elevator-100 ``` 3. Open index.html in any web browser. ## License Distributed under the ```MIT License```. See LICENSE for more information.
